description: Generic drug availability (FDA) — Is there a generic for this drug? From FDA Drugs@FDA: the reference brand(s), every approved ANDA generic for the same active-ingredient set grouped by dosage form and route, marketed vs discontinued products, number of marketed generic makers and competition level (NONE/LIMITED/MODERATE/HIGH), therapeutic-equivalence (TE) codes and AB-rating, strengths, first and latest generic approval dates, tentative approvals, and signals like few makers or brand discontinued. brand= or ingredient= (use A+B for combinations); optional limit= products (default 40). Example: /v1/fda/generics?brand=Lipitor Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
